name: Nasal helm
description: A conical helm with a bar down the face. It protects the nose and gives you the look of a man with opinions.
notes: Medium helmet at the mail reference weight. Weight 2 kg (ADR-0003 reference weights). Catalogue tier common (economy doc, helmets medium 70-120). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
